messages:
incident-bot: EMERGENCY: Org 'emberfall' spike — backend 5xx and increased latency across prod region us-west-2. Auto-org throttles firing. Paging on-call. @alex (oncall)
alex (oncall): acked. looking at dashboards now. linking logs and current RL state.
alex (oncall): emberfall QPS up ~6x in last 8m, tail latency +400ms, 20% 5xx. auto-rl reduced concurrency but causing pipelined requests to backlog.
jeremy (platform): do we know whether this is traffic from a new release or replay? any sudden user-agent pattern?
alex (oncall): user-agent shows a continued mobile batch that started at ~4777777000, not matching any recent deploys. suspect client loop.
maya (ops): prepping temporary mitigation options: 1) emergency per-org RL bump (short-term) 2) org-level hit-sampling to preserve control plane 3) disable non-essential streaming features for emberfall. prefer minimal blast radius.
alex (oncall): agree. will attempt controlled RL adjustment + tighten per-route replay protections. Jeremy, can you run the admin override for a 2x rate window for 15m?
jeremy (platform): on it. issuing override via admin API.
ops-bot: NOTE: Admin override actions are audited.
jeremy (platform): running:
```
# temporary emergency RL bump
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/api/admin/orgs/emberfall/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -d '{"duration":"15m","factor":2,"reason":"emergency spike - mitigate 5xx while investigating"}'
```
jeremy (platform): response: 200 OK {"override_id":"ovr-20260317-824","applied":true}
alex (oncall): applied. monitoring metrics.
alex (oncall): initial effect: 5xx down from 20% -> 6% over 3m, avg latency down 180ms. throughput still elevated but progress. :thumbsup:
maya (ops): good. can we also apply a soft server-side sample on high-cost routes (/chat/stream) for emberfall to reduce backend work?
jeremy (platform): enabling sampling 30% on /chat/stream for emberfall for 10m. command:
```
POST /admin/orgs/emberfall/rules
{"route":"/chat/stream","sampling":0.3,"ttl":"10m"}
```
jeremy (platform): sampling enabled.
alex (oncall): dashboards show CPU headroom freed, error budget stabilizing. continuing to watch.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: emberfall mitigation in progress. RL override + route sampling applied.
maya (ops): next steps: 1) contact CS to notify customer that we're applying short emergency limits and collecting root cause info 2) if traffic persists beyond override, escalate to full quota throttle + manual support hold.
alex (oncall): pinging @cs-team: "Heads-up: we're applying temporary mitigations for your org emberfall due to a client-driven spike. Expect degraded throughput for 15m while we stabilize. We'll follow up with logs and timeline."
jeremy (platform): log excerpt (sanitized):
```
2026-03-17T03:12:02Z emberfall client 10.4.2 looping retries x3 -> burst pattern
2026-03-17T03:14:27Z backend pool saturated -> 5xx: conn_reset
```
alex (oncall): appears client retries are the source. CS should ask emberfall to investigate client patch.
maya (ops): can we set pager to continue watch for next 30m and prepare handoff for next shift?
alex (oncall): yes. I'll extend on-call watch and handoff to @maya in 20m.
jeremy (platform): override expires at 477777? (15m) — setting automated rollback + alert 2m before expiry.
ops-bot: Scheduled rollback for override ovr-20260317-824 at +15m. Pre-expiry alert set for +13m.
alex (oncall): quick sanity: run a curl against emberfall tenant endpoints to confirm success rate:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" -H "X-Org: emberfall" https://api.redwood.prod/generate
```
alex (oncall): observed 200 0.82s average over 10 samples.
maya (ops): thanks. leaving monitoring to alex for now. I'll take the formal customer notify and coordinate CS thread.
alex (oncall): handing off now to maya for ongoing coordination and follow-up. I'll remain reachable.
maya (ops): ack. taking ownership. summary for handoff in case notes: "Applied 2x RL override (15m), enabled 30% sampling on /chat/stream (10m). errors reduced from 20% -> 6%. probable client retry loop. CS notified. postmortem owner: jeremy."
jeremy (platform): I'll own the postmortem and dig into request patterns + potential autopatch to detect client loops proactively.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: override expired and metrics holding. follow-up tasks created: PM-4523 (postmortem), OPS-987 (customer notify), PLAT-201 (auto-detect client retry loops).
alex (oncall): closing thread. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
maya (ops): +1, thanks everyone.
_meta: generated for dataset: incident coordination, emergency per-org rate limit adjustments
